name: CRWV AI GPU Cloud Infrastructure Valuation
rationale: CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) is the pure-play leader in dedicated high-density AI/GPU cloud infrastructure, compounding revenue to $5.13B (+112.5% YoY) with 71.7% gross margins. At $81.23, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $249.87 (+207.6% upside at 8.16% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 14.0% CAGR, below our 18.0% bear case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 15.0 shares, 4.04% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $75.44, trim Tier 1 at $150.00+.

bear.rationale: Hyperscaler in-house GPU cloud capacity expands; high asset-backed debt service costs compress net margin to 10% on $11.7B Y5 revenue.
risks: Asset-backed debt refinancing costs under sustained higher interest rates
Hyperscaler price competition on standard AI training cluster rentals

base.rationale: Leading AI labs (Inflection, Mistral, Meta) scale on CoreWeave Cloud; Weights & Biases platform integration secures $23.9B Y5 revenue at 22% net margin.
risks: Customer concentration across top 5 AI research labs
Power interconnection delays at newly acquired data center sites

bull.rationale: CoreWeave becomes the premier hyperscale AI Neocloud globally; proprietary orchestration and software tooling command 28% net margin on $45.6B revenue.
risks: Antitrust scrutiny over NVIDIA preferential GPU allocation terms
Rapid shifts toward in-house customer ASIC deployments
